recovery: A pre-start cache-availability estimate rejected trace 258 before any container or command. Included half active file cache in the estimate and completed remaining seven; same placement, 24 GiB limit and observation algorithm.
performance_caveat: Write protection, write-fault probes and disabled THP change CPU cost, latency and MPKI; do not compare these performance counters directly with prior uninstrumented runs.
host_scope: Common Docker daemon, kernel and pre-existing shared image cache are not isolated.
